newsitem.title: JAPAN: Enix to make popular game software for PlayStation.
newsitem.headline: Enix to make popular game software for PlayStation.

text.p: Japan videogame software maker Enix Corp said on Tuesday it will develop and supply the latest version of one of its best-selling videogame software packages, "Dragon Quest VII," for Sony Corp's 32-bit game player PlayStation.
Enix also said on Tuesday it had also agreed with Sega Enterprises Ltd to develop and sell software for Sega's 32-bit game player Sega Saturn.
Enix said in a statement that prices and the launch date of the "Dragon Quest VII" software for PlayStation have not been decided.
Enix has so far produced Dragon Quest series software only for the industry leader Nintendo Co.
It did not say in the statement whether it would continue development and sales of the Dragon Quest software for Nintendo.
